sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: AAA Game Asset 3D Sculpting and Character Rigging Studio

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of Panama (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid civil law system with U.S.-influenced corporate law principles; statutory corporate framework principally derived from the Commercial Code, the Civil Code, and Ley 32 de 1927
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 2012, including investment chapter)
Panama-Canada Free Trade Agreement (FTA, in force 2013)
Panama-Mexico Protocol to FTA / bilateral investment provisions
Double taxation agreements in force with the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Spain, Mexico, Singapore, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (Panama AML/CFT framework), as amended by Ley No. 70 de 2019 and implementing Decreto Ejecutivo No. 363 de 2015; Ley No. 52 de 2016 (mandatory beneficial-owner information and transparency obligations); regulation by the Dirección Nacional de Inteligencia Financiera (DNIF) and the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), in coordination with the Public Registry of Panama for corporate records.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (tax and AML authorities have access; beneficial owner records are not publicly searchable; registered agent must maintain and produce updated UBO information upon lawful request)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the proposed or registered Articles of Incorporation (Copia certificada del Acta Constitutiva / Estatutos)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registro Público de Panamá or Panamanian notary in the case of preliminary instrument
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent Panamanian authentication authority; if the receiving state is not an Apostille member, consular legalization through a Panamanian consulate is mandatory

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Personality (Certificado de Existencia y Personería Jurídica)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Panamanian consular legalization as determined by the recipient jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Registered Agent and Registered Office (Certificado de Agente Residente y Oficina Registrada)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panamanian licensed resident agent or corporate services provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn beneficial ownership declaration (Declaración Jurada de Beneficiario Final) required by Ley 52 de 2016
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered agent, notary, or the legal entity itself certified by management
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and apostille for use with foreign financial institutions; DGI-facing filings are direct electronic submissions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Poder General) granting corporate representation for bank account opening, contract execution, and regulatory filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and Hague Apostille where a foreign receiving party requires authentication

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, resident agents, and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and Panama's national lists maintained by the DNIF; heightened PEP due diligence for domestic and foreign politically exposed persons, including family members and close associates per FATF Recommendation 12; enhanced monitoring where any shareholder or controller appears on a sanctions or enforcement list; UBO information must be updated within statutory deadlines and available to DGI, DNIF, and law enforcement under Ley 23 de 2015 as amended.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá — Sistema de Servicio en Línea (Reserva de Nombre / Consulta de Disponibilidad), available at the official portal of the Registro Público de Panamá
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory names must contain or constitute 'Sociedad Anónima' or the abbreviation 'S.A.'; names may be in Spanish or other Roman-alphabet languages; any non-Roman script must be transliterated into Latin characters by the filer; the name must be readily pronounceable for Panamanian registry indexing and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the filer may file a writ of reconsideration (recurso de reconsideración) with the Administración General del Registro Público within 10 business days of notification, followed by an optional hierarchical appeal (recurso de apelación). The appeal must include the proposed name, a comparative list of cited conflicting names, evidence of authorized use if a sensitive token triggered the rejection, and legal arguments on distinctiveness; statutory fees apply at each stage.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual mailbox or administrative address is permissible for correspondence only if a licensed Panamanian resident agent maintains a physical corporate office in Panama and that office is designated as the statutory registered office; a purely virtual office without a resident agent and physical registered office is not accepted for Sociedad Anónima formation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low quantified risk for a low-risk creative-services BPO: approximately 3-6% annual probability of a routine compliance visit by DGI or the municipality, and below 2% probability of an unannounced AML field inspection given the non-financial, low-risk business classification.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and reservation request for two proposed corporate names
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff fixed by the Registro Público fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting, notarization, and execution of the Sociedad Anónima Articles of Incorporation and statutory by-laws in Spanish
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panamanian notary public / licensed law firm

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate registration and inscription fee at the Public Registry for the new Sociedad Anónima
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory Tarifa del Registro Público de Panamá

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and resident agent services, first annual cycle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Panamanian resident agent / corporate services law firm

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Municipal business operation notice (aviso de operación) and industry license for professional creative services
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Municipalidad corresponding to the registered office location
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Local municipal tariff based on estimated revenue bracket

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Tax registration and activation of the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) with DGI
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the incorporation notice/edict in a Panamanian legal gazette or designated newspaper, where required for registry effectiveness
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Designated official publication / newspaper of record

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and legalization bundle for bank onboarding, foreign counterparties, and execution of international outsourcing contracts
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores / Panamanian competent authentication authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory apostille fee plus professional handling/courier charges

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades (Law No. 32 of 1927), Articles 2–28, 35–58; Complementary provisions of Executive Decree No. 4 of 1980 and Law No. 5 of 2017 (digital filing and registration).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Registro Mercantil (Public Registry of Panama, Mercantile Registration Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (Public Deed of Incorporation of a Corporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; at least one share must be issued and subscribed. The authorized capital is stated in the deed; paid-in capital may be zero or nominal, and no escrow or bank deposit is required at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the incorporation deed and bye-laws are approved and adopted. RESOLVED: That the subscribers are appointed as the inaugural Board of Directors, and the board accepts the subscribed share capital as reflected in the incorporation deed. RESOLVED: That the registered office of the Corporation be established at the address designated in the Public Registry, and the registered agent is retained for service of process. RESOLVED: That the following officers are appointed: President, Secretary and Treasurer, each with authority to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and conduct ordinary business. RESOLVED: That these resolutions take effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Registry of Panama – Electronic Name Search System (online via www.registro-publico.gob.pa or in-person veta office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three (3) proposed corporate names in order of preference via the Public Registry's online platform. When a name is found available, reserve it for a 30-day period. Pay the nominal reservation fee with a registered credit card or at a designated Banco Nacional de Panamá window.
required_dossiers: Completed name reservation application
Copy of applicant's ID (cedula) or passport
Power of attorney (if agent submits on behalf)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any name is rejected due to similarity or prohibited term, the applicant may submit a new name immediately or file a written argument against refusal within 10 business days for administrative review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and notarization of the articles of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in Panama (Notaría Pública) with mandatory attorney drafting under the Ley General de Sociedades
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Panamanian attorney to draft the Escritura Pública de Constitución, specifying the corporate purpose (including 3D game art outsourcing), share structure, director and officer names, registered office, and term. Present the draft to a notary along with identification documents. Sign the deed in person or by attorney-in-fact under a sworn power of attorney.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of incorporation
Valid passport or cedula of each incorporator
Power of attorney (if applicable)
Certificate of name reservation from the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies inconsistencies, amendments are made in a separate additive deed or by re-executing the original document before signature. Notary fees may be adjusted accordingly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the corporation at the Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Registro Mercantil (Mercantile Registration Section)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Escritura Pública with the Public Registry, together with the registration fee payment of USD 250.00 (plus notary and formalities), either physically at the main facilities or electronically via the Legal Transfer of Domain portal. The Registry examines the deed for legal compliance and issues the Mercantile Certificate (Certificado de Registro).
required_dossiers: Original notarized public deed
Copy of name reservation certificate
Official payment receipt (tasa) from the Public Registry
Statutory form containing the fiduciary duty declaration (for directors)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry raises a 'reparo' (observation), the applicant's attorney has 15 business days to correct or supplement the filing. Failure to respond within that period may result in rejection; a new application may be submitted with additional fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining tax identification number (RUC) and corporate certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministry of Economy and Finance, and the Public Registry certified documentation window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the certified corporate registration decision to the DGI and apply for the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC). Simultaneously, obtain a certified copy of the 'Certificado de Persona Jurídica' from the Public Registry, which confirms the company's existence and legal representatives. Registration is required for tax and municipal purposes.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered public deed
Public Registry Mercantile Certificate
Identity documents of directors and officers
Proof of registered office address
Completed DGI form 802-01
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUC application is queried due to missing information, the DGI issues a written specification of deficiencies. File the correct evidence within 5 business days to avoid reapplication; attorneys can escalate to the DGI regional office if delay exceeds 10 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legalization of corporate books and filing of officer appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá and the provincial tax administration (for fiscal stamping of books)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Stamp and legalize the corporate books (shareholder register, directors' register, meeting minutes book) at the Public Registry administrative window. Present the officer appointment minutes for registration. Additionally, apply for the municipal 'Aviso de Operación' at the city hall of the registered office municipality to authorize physical business operation.
required_dossiers: Physical corporate books (blank and numbered)
Officer appointment resolution signed by the board
Certified copy of the public deed
RUC certificate
Lease or ownership proof of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the books are rejected due to physical defects or missing stamps, purchase and re-present new books. If the officer appointment filing is rejected, correct the padronal signature or pay the appropriate stamp tax and refile within the Registry's correction timeframe.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) – Directorate for Commercial and Industrial Regulations
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Municipal Operating Notice) and Complementary Patente Comercial e Industrial issued by the local municipality

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) – National Environmental Evaluation Directorate
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 1 – Registration (low-impact service activity): office-based 3D art outsourcing does not require a full Environmental Impact Assessment, but must submit a simple environmental registration form
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater generated; office sewage must comply with municipal sewer standards and MiAMBIENTE Resolution AG-0289-2017 discharge limits (BOD5 ≤ 200 mg/L, total suspended solids ≤ 220 mg/L). Volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions from painting or molding equipment, if any, must be controlled to below 500 ppm hourly average. Solid waste must follow national hazardous waste guidelines and be disposed via licensed contractors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (Certificado de Inspección de Bomberos) from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá, workplace health and safety registration with MITRADEL, a structural load inspection certificate from the municipality's Building Department (if the premises are in a commercial building), and a general business operation clearance issued by the local health authority (Región de Salud).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas — online portal e-Tax 2.0 at https://www.dgi.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Panama S.A. must first be incorporated by Notary Public and registered in the Public Registry. The legal representative then obtains the company RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) through the DGI e-Tax 2.0 portal using the public registry filing certificate, corporate ID, notarized bylaws, and the appointed resident agent details. Simultaneously, the company files an Aviso de Operación with the municipality and, if taxable transactions will occur, completes the ITBMS registration. No minimum capital deposit is required for the RUC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box election exists in Panama. Panama S.A. entities are automatically taxed on Panama-source income only, with foreign-source income excluded. Available statutory mechanisms include the optional Multinational Company Headquarters (SEM/MNE) regime under Law 41 of 2007, the Panama Pacifico special regime, and the Ciudad del Saber special regime; these are elective tax regimes with advance approval from SEM and DGI. No hybrid mismatch election is available, but a taxpayer may elect from DGI-approved accounting methods and depreciation rules subject to the territorial source rule.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) — Panama's VAT-equivalent tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: B/. 36,000 (approx. USD 36,000) in annual taxable revenue or taxable service value; above this threshold the taxpayer must file monthly ITBMS returns and issue electronic invoices through DGI-authorised systems. Below the threshold, the small-taxpayer simplified regime may apply.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica) is progressively enforced by DGI Resolution 201-2022 and subsequent technical amendments. RUC holders with economic activity must issue XML-based invoices through DGI-authorised service providers (or the SIFE system), transmit invoice data in real time via DGI-restful APIs, and obtain a valid digital hash/stamp before fiscal invoicing is enforceable. Each invoice receives a DGI-authenticated Código de Verificación and is subject to near-real-time schema and tax clearance validation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exportation of tangible goods from Panama, and export of services rendered from Panama to a foreign recipient where the service is used or exploited outside Panama, are eligible for a 0% ITBMS rate. For goods, the transaction must be evidenced by a customs export declaration and physical departure of the goods. For offshore services such as 3D game art outsourcing and character rigging, the service contract must state the foreign client is located abroad and that the benefit of the service occurs outside Panama; the inward foreign currency remittance must correspond to the exact service provided.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Panama Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Mercancías / DUA)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing export
Service Contract, Statement of Work, or Purchase Order from the non-resident client
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT credit advice evidencing foreign currency repatriation
DGI Export Certificate or ITBMS zero-rating schedule as required by the fiscal authority
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Exporters are subject to retrospective DGI and customs audit review within the standard 5-year statute of limitations. If export documentation is found incomplete, fake, or non-repatriated within the 180-day period, the DGI will claw back the 0% benefit and convert the ITBMS to 7% with interest; penalties range from 100% of the evaded tax, monetary fines up to B/. 50,000, suspension of export invoice privileges, and possible criminal fraud charges under Panama's tax crime and customs law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) — the banking and foreign-exchange supervisory authority; Banco Nacional de Panamá is the State's fiscal agent. Panama does not operate a fiat-issuing central bank; the US Dollar is lawful currency under full dollarization (Decree Law 7 of 1955).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full and unrestricted convertibility on both capital and current account. The Balboa is a nominal unit at parity 1:1 with the USD and exists only as fractional coins. There are no exchange controls, no surrender requirements, no prior authorization for profit remittances, and no restrictions on dividends, royalties, or cross-border services payments to non-resident shareholders. The only operational hurdle is bank-level AML/KYC due diligence and documentary proof of the underlying commercial transaction to withstand OFAC and international sanctions screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory surrender of export proceeds and no mandatory conversion ratio because the domestic legal tender is the US Dollar. Exporters must retain independently verifiable documentation (service agreement, invoices, SWIFT/MT103 traces) for compliance with Ley 41 de 2007 and SBP Agreement No. 005-2009 on anti-money-laundering duties.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium feasibility. Panama has no domestic EMI licensing regime, and offshore digital EMIs generally accept Panamanian S.A.s only on a discretionary basis due to the jurisdiction's historic offshore designation; the determining factor is whether the EMI's sponsor bank tolerates Panama as a UBO jurisdiction under enhanced due diligence. A compliant alternative is to use a PayPal Business account anchored to a local Tier-1 USD bank settlement account and to limit EMI usage to segregated EUR/GBP collection through escrow-style arrangements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical appearance of at least one director, principal shareholder, or a Panama-licensed attorney-in-fact holding a notarized and apostilled power of attorney is required at most Tier-1 banks. Remote video KYC is permitted only on a discretionary case-by-case basis where (i) the S.A. is introduced by a licensed resident agent in good standing, (ii) all corporate and UBO records are pre-vetted by the bank's compliance unit, and (iii) the Operational Risk Committee approves digital onboarding. In all cases, original bank forms and mandates must be signed in person or before a Panamanian notary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident UBO with no visible Panama economic nexus
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the S.A. registration certificate from the Registro Público, updated franchise tax certificate (Paz y Salvo), UBO declaration under Ley 52 de 2016, RUC registration, board minutes approving the account opening and appointing authorized signatories, plus the master services agreement proving the AAA game 3D art outsourcing business activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically Exposed Person (PEP) or residency in a sanctioned/high-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative PEP self-certification, source-of-wealth statement supported by bank statements or asset ownership records, tax paid certificates, completion of the bank's enhanced due diligence questionnaire, and where any UBO triggers OFAC/EU/UN alerts, an independent sanctions counsel opinion with transactional flow analysis.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High turnover of digital payments with rapid cross-border wire-out (PayPal inflow then disbursement)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Validated client contracts with offshore game studios, itemized invoices and scope-of-work documents under ISIC 7490, 12-month projected cash flow, PayPal settlement statements, and a signed undertaking to record the UN/CFE-suitable purpose code for other business services on every outward remittance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial shareholder capital injection during onboarding period
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal capital contribution agreement, authenticated share issuance entries in the corporation's share register, source-of-funds evidence from the remitting bank, and a declaration that no cash deposits will be introduced during the compliance rehabilitation window.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 with the beneficiary USD account at a Tier-1 Panamanian bank. The sender's payment reference must state 'APORTE DE CAPITAL — INICIO DE OPERACIONES' or 'SHAREHOLDER LOAN — WORKING CAPITAL NO SUJETO A CONTROLES CAMBIARIOS'. No prior SBP authorization is required because Panama has no exchange-control gatekeeper; however, the receiving bank will apply a 1–5 business day settlement hold pending sanctions screening of the remitter's SWIFT BIC and the evidentiary bundle. For tax efficacy, the injection should be recorded as paid-in capital or a documented shareholder loan in the company's records and, where applicable, endorsed in the Registro Público filing.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: SWIFT MT103 is the primary clearing rail for low-to-mid-value creative services, software licensing, and subcontractor settlements; the ordering customer field must carry the corporate RUC to avoid rejection. For milestone payments exceeding approximately USD 50,000, an irrevocable commercial Letter of Credit (UCP 600) issued by a local Tier-1 bank or an international confirming bank provides settlement security with progress certificates. Intra-country vendor payments may use ACH Panama (Cámara de Compensación), while PayPal Payouts to independent contractors are acceptable for small amounts provided each payout references the underlying invoice and is reconciled to the USD bank account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Offshore USD/EUR forward contracts executed with a licensed international bank desk (no local prohibition, and admissible on the cash-flow hedge policy because Panama operates under USD legal tender)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for receivables quoted in emerging-market currencies (e.g., USD/CNY, USD/BRL, USD/MXN) where the S.A. bills clients in USD
Cross-currency swaps with OECD-licensed counterparties to neutralize multi-year, multicurrency milestone contracts without Panama-specific regulatory charges
Over-the-counter FX options for USD/GBP and USD/JPY exposure arising from revenue nominated in GBP or JPY by European and Japanese game publishers

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Payment of the S.A. annual franchise tax ('Tasa Única Anual de la Sociedad Anónima')
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance of Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due every calendar year between January 1 and January 31; where January 31 falls on a non-banking day, the deadline is the next business day.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs monthly surcharge/interest and graduated fines; non-payment for two consecutive years results in a default notation, and persistent non-payment for three years may lead to administrative strike-off of the corporate registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate register audit and maintenance certificate (confirmation of issued shares, directors, officers, and registered office records)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Retained internal record; produced to DGI, Registro Público, or the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) upon lawful request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Completed by the resident agent by March 31 following each fiscal year-end; any share transfer occurring during the year must be recorded in the share register on the transfer date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate government fine, but absence of an accurate share register, director register, or minute book can result in director/officer fines, weakened corporate-veil protection, and AML compliance sanctions under Law 23 of 2015.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit is triggered for a Panamanian S.A. only when: (i) annual gross income from Panamanian-source operations exceeds B/.3,000,000; (ii) total assets exceed B/.6,000,000; (iii) the entity qualifies as a 'Gran Contribuyente' (large taxpayer); or (iv) it engages in regulated financial, insurance, trust, or gaming activity. A non-operating parent holding company and a foreign-source game-art outsourcing S.A. normally fall below these triggers, so no statutory audit is required.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS/NIIF as adopted in Panama; private SMEs meeting the size tests may apply 'IFRS for SMEs'; statutory books and accounting records may be kept in Spanish or English for non-regulated entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no public annual UBO filing for a standard Panama S.A. However, before the annual compliance cut-off the resident agent must obtain a signed shareholder/director confirmation of current beneficial ownership; every share transfer executed during the year must be recorded in the share register with names, dates, and transfer details, and the updated register pages must be certified by the corporate secretary. For AML purposes, original evidence of share transfers and UBO attestation must be retained and produced to the Unidad de Análisis Financiero upon request.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 for an exempt passive/foreign-source S.A.; USD 3,000 – USD 6,500 when audited financial statements are required or requested by financial counterparties.
